preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in [n, m])
preconditions.description: n and m are positive integers where n is the number of videos and m is the disk size in MB.
a is a list of exactly n integers representing video sizes.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= m for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each video size a_i is an integer between 1 and m (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum total time required to watch all videos.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == min(total_time(a, n, m) for a in [a])
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum possible time required to watch all videos, computed as the sum of download times and watching times, considering disk constraints and optimal scheduling.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == sum(a) + n if sum(a) <= m else min_time(a, n, m)
postconditions.description: If the total size of all videos is ≤ m, the output is sum(a) + n (download all at once, then watch sequentially). Otherwise, it is the minimum time computed by an optimal scheduling algorithm that accounts for disk space constraints.
